control_scope: Full accepted dataset, identical splits, features, model settings and early-stopping policy; separate refits; no test-driven changes.

uncertainty.method: paired borrower percentile bootstrap on locked test predictions
uncertainty.pairing: same test borrower IDs and resampled indices across every model and control

comparisons: headline minus order-shuffle for each model
headline minus label-permutation for each model
label-permutation minus constant inner-training-prevalence reference for each model
interpretation: Point-score lead alone does not establish a clear difference. Temporal-order evidence requires the paired full-minus-order-shuffle GRU interval; static order-shuffle predictions should remain unchanged. Bootstrap uncertainty is conditional on this seed and fitted models, not training-run variability.
policy: No generator, accepted dataset, parameter, or model-setting changes based on test results.
confidence_note: Intervals are nominal paired 95% percentile intervals, conditional on the fitted models and this simulation seed; no multiplicity-adjusted or across-training-seed claims.
backend_policy: User requested Colab before GPU results. Rerun headline and both controls on one GPU backend; retain CPU runs separately and never select best backend by scores.
